title: Movie Dream Scenario
content: Movie Spoilers Ahead! Last night I watched the 2023 movie Dream Scenario with Nicholas Cage. I thought I was a great movie. Cage (who plays Paul) did a great job playing a professor of evolutionary biology. I was thinking that the dream company (I apologize, but I forget the name of it) with the wrist band...I think they used Paul as the fall guy/patsy to market their dream wrist band & company. In the end, they destroyed his life, & made him complicit with their agenda (he had to go on tour to sell "his" book, but they literally changed the title of it without telling him--the new title is about terror), because he was so beatened down from everything they stole from his life; his dignity, some of his sanity, his marriage, & his job as a tenured professor. Anyway, they took him into Mall World to visit thousands of people--total strangers. At first, the visits were 100% benign. He would just appear in people's dreams. Then eventually the dreams became nightmares. Paul would attack these same people...brutalizing them in horrible ways I will not go into. It got so bad, he was barred from public spaces, because he was triggering people, because people were remembering their terrifying nightmares. But honestly, none of these horrible activities were being done *by* Paul. Paul was a genuinely gentle, peaceful family man, who was utterly perplexed by all the hullabaloo. He was angry & upset at people's reactions to their dreams. He himself was literally not there. Someone else was wearing him or his face in the dreams, & torturing these people under the guise of Paul. But...I also understand the dreamers point of view. It is terrifying to wake up from nightmares like these, & carry those memories around with you all day, like a heavy cloak you cannot shrug off. Eventually, after the profound breakup of his marriage, & the loss of his beloved job, he caved in to the marketing company. We see Paul having to compromise himself in embarrassing pictures to sell his book, just to keep himself together financially. There's alot more in here I left out, but again, I thought it was a great movie that is possibly about Mall World.
